title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
和狮子握手的老鼠
hé shī zi wò shǒu de lǎo shǔ
page_text_en:
The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion
hé shī zi wò shǒu de lǎo shǔ
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《和狮子握手的老鼠》及其拼音，背景为粉色。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
一大早，胖胖鳄鱼就来问他的好朋友们：“我们今天一起玩什么游戏呢？”
“玩捉迷藏吧！捉迷藏最开心了。”小老鼠说。小老鼠最喜欢玩捉迷藏游戏。他个子小，随便往哪儿一躲，

别人就怎么也找不到。
“不玩捉迷藏。”小兔子说，“昨天刚玩过。”
page_text_en:
Early in the morning, the chubby crocodile came to ask his good friends, "What game shall we play today?"
"Let's play hide-and-seek! Hide-and-seek is the most fun," said the little mouse. The little mouse loved playing hide-and-seek. He was small, so he could just hide anywhere,

and no one could find him.
"Let's not play hide-and-seek," said the little rabbit. "We just played it yesterday."
summary_zh: 胖胖鳄鱼询问朋友们想玩什么游戏，小老鼠提议玩捉迷藏，但小兔子表示昨天刚玩过，不想再玩。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
胖熊说:“我们来画画吧。我的好朋友狮子是一只非常漂亮、非常棒的狮子,咱们请他当模特。”

“好哇!”小刺猬和胖胖鳄鱼都说,“这是个好主意,画画太有意思了。”

“我害怕。”小老鼠说,“假如狮子发起脾气来,会不会把我们都吃掉?”

“才不会呢,他是一只挺温和的狮子。”胖熊说着就出门去找他的好朋友狮子了。

不一会儿,胖胖鳄鱼和他的伙伴们就来到大橡树下,给狮子画像。
page_text_en:
The fat bear said, "Let's draw! My good friend the lion is a very beautiful and wonderful lion. Let's ask him to be our model."

"Great!" the little hedgehog and the fat crocodile said, "That's a great idea, drawing is so much fun!"

"I'm scared," said the little mouse, "What if the lion gets angry and eats us all?"

"No way! He's a very gentle lion," said the fat bear, and then he went out to find his good friend the lion.

Soon after, the fat crocodile and his friends arrived under the big oak tree to draw the lion.
summary_zh: 胖熊提议为他的好朋友狮子画像，小刺猬和胖胖鳄鱼表示赞同，但小老鼠担心狮子会发脾气吃掉大家。胖熊安慰大家后出门去找狮子，伙伴们随后也来到大橡树下准备画画。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
狮子很客气地和大家打个招呼，
就坐在大树下，让大家给他画像。
伙伴们都围着狮子，举起画笔认真地画了起来。
只听见画笔在纸上唰唰地响着……
胖胖鳄鱼检查一下大家画得怎么样，小兔子、小刺猬、胖熊画得都不错。
胖胖鳄鱼在小老鼠身边停下了，
他说：“小老鼠，你这是画的什么呀？”
page_text_en:
The lion politely greeted everyone,
then sat under the big tree, letting everyone draw his portrait.
Everyone gathered around the lion, picking up their brushes and drawing carefully.
They could only hear the brushes making a '唰唰' sound on the paper...
Fat Crocodile checked everyone's drawings. The little rabbit, the hedgehog, and the fat bear all drew well.
Fat Crocodile stopped beside the little mouse,
and said, "Little mouse, what are you drawing?"
summary_zh: 狮子坐在大树下让大家为他画像，小动物们认真作画，胖胖鳄鱼检查后发现小老鼠画的内容与众不同，便好奇地问他画的是什么。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
大家围过来一看，小老鼠把狮子画成了一只凶巴巴的猫，都笑了起来。
听到大伙儿的笑声，狮子说：“能让我也看看吗？”
胖胖鳄鱼把小老鼠的画递给了狮子。
狮子看着画也张嘴笑了，他说：
“我是猫吗？我有这么凶吗？我可是一只挺温和的狮子。”
“狮子从来不欺负谁！”胖熊说。
page_text_en:
Everyone gathered around to take a look. The little mouse had drawn the lion as a fierce-looking cat, and everyone laughed.
Hearing everyone's laughter, the lion said, "Can I take a look too?"
The chubby crocodile handed the mouse's drawing to the lion.
The lion looked at the drawing and smiled. He said:
"Am I a cat? Am I really this fierce? I'm actually a pretty gentle lion."
"Lions never bully anyone!" said the fat bear.
summary_zh: 小老鼠画的狮子被大家看到后，狮子笑着询问能否看看，并表示自己其实很温和，胖熊也补充说狮子从不欺负别人。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
“连老鼠也不欺负吗？”小老鼠大胆地问。
“我从来都不欺负老鼠。我有很多老鼠朋友。”狮子还是温和地笑着。
小老鼠不好意思地说：“我要重画一张。”

大家的画都画完了。狮子一张张地看着。
他指着小老鼠的画说：“我最喜欢这张，小老鼠把我画得又威武又温和。这张画能送给我吗？我想把它挂在我家墙上呢。”
page_text_en:
"Even mice? You don't bully mice?" the little mouse asked boldly.
"I never bully mice. I have many mouse friends," the lion said, still smiling gently.
The little mouse said awkwardly, "I want to redraw it."

Everyone had finished their drawings. The lion looked at them one by one.
He pointed at the little mouse's drawing and said, "I like this one best. You drew me both brave and gentle, little mouse. Can I have this drawing? I want to hang it on my wall at home."
summary_zh: 小老鼠询问狮子是否欺负老鼠，狮子表示自己从不欺负老鼠并有许多老鼠朋友。小老鼠因画得不够好而想重画，但狮子非常喜欢他的画，并请求将画送给他挂在家中。

title_en: The Mouse Who Shook Hands with the Lion at 31
page_text_ocr_zh:
“当然可以。”小老鼠高兴地说，
“我以后还要画一张更好的。”
“谢谢你，小老鼠！”狮子伸出他的
大手和小老鼠的小手使劲握了握。
page_text_en:
"Of course!" the little mouse said happily,
"I'll draw an even better one next time."
"Thank you, little mouse!" the lion extended his
big hand and firmly shook the little mouse's small hand.
summary_zh: 小老鼠答应狮子以后会画更好的画，狮子感谢他并伸出大手与小老鼠的小手紧紧相握。
